# Pixel Notes

A concise, offline pixel-art-styled notes app with three tabs (Work, Home, Ideas). Each tab has its own text area, and content is preserved when switching tabs. Character counts update per tab, and notes are saved in localStorage.

## Features

- Three tabs with keyboard navigation (arrow keys, Home, End)
- Per-tab text areas that retain content when switching
- Live character count per tab
- Content persisted in localStorage
- Fully responsive from 360px wide
- Pixel-art aesthetic with visible hover, focus, and pressed states

## Usage

Open `index.html` in any modern browser. No server or build step required.

## Files

- `index.html` – structure
- `styles.css` – styling
- `app.js` – logic
